text_en: Praise the Lord ! I will give thanks to the Lord with my whole heart, in the company of the upright, in the congregation.
text_cn: 亚肋路亚。 在义人的集会和团聚中， 我必要全心向上主赞颂。

text_en: Great are the works of the Lord , studied by all who delight in them.
text_cn: 上主的化工确实伟大， 凡喜爱他的必须究察。

text_en: Full of honor and majesty is his work, and his righteousness endures forever.
text_cn: 他的作为辉煌光明， 他的正义永远常存。

text_en: He has gained renown by his wonderful deeds; the Lord is gracious and merciful.
text_cn: 他使他的奇迹不可遗忘， 上主实在是慈爱而温良。

text_en: He provides food for those who fear him; he is ever mindful of his covenant.
text_cn: 他赐给敬畏他的人食物， 且永远怀念自己的盟约，

text_en: He has shown his people the power of his works, in giving them the heritage of the nations.
text_cn: 将他伟业的异能启示给选民， 把外邦人的产业赏赐给他们。

text_en: The works of his hands are faithful and just; all his precepts are trustworthy.
text_cn: 他手所行的是忠诚正义， 他的一切规诫坚定不移，

text_en: They are established forever and ever, to be performed with faithfulness and uprightness.
text_cn: 为万世万代永远立定， 全是基于真理和公正。

text_en: He sent redemption to his people; he has commanded his covenant forever. Holy and awesome is his name.
text_cn: 他速来救赎他的百姓， 永远立定了他的约盟； 他的名是神圣而可敬。

text_en: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom; all those who practice it have a good understanding. His praise endures forever.
text_cn: 敬畏上主，是智慧的开始： 实行敬畏的人，算有智慧； 他的荣誉，必定存留永世。
